crossRefs.note: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”
They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the…
Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.
Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria.…
My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.
It will happen, that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Engedi
people.line: Oasis in Judah; refuge for David; Chedorlaomer's victory

translations.web: David went up from there, and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.
translations.bsb: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En-gedi.
translations.kjv: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.
